title: ArrayList and Wrapper Types
summary: The growable ArrayList - adding, getting, setting, removing, searching and sorting - the List interface, wrapper classes like Integer and Double, autoboxing and its traps (remove by index or value, == on Integers, null unboxing), List.of, and iterating while removing safely.

cards.q: Why can you not write List<int>?
cards.a: Generic collections hold objects only; use the wrapper type List<Integer>.

cards.q: On a List<Integer>, what does list.remove(1) remove?
cards.a: The item at index 1; to remove the value 1, call list.remove(Integer.valueOf(1)).
